text: في الدقيقة 45، سجل إلياس أوكافور هدفًا رائعًا لفريق Harbour City بعد تمريرة ذكية من مارك باروس، ليصبح النتيجة 1-0 لصالحهم[#905]. الهدف جاء بعد هجمة منظمة استمرت حوالي 57 ثانية بها 17 تمريرة قصيرة وصبر كبير من اللاعبين[#883 إلى #905]. الفريق سيطر على الكرة بنسبة 57% في آخر 10 دقائق، مما ساعدهم على تجاوز دفاع Seabrook Town الذي يعتمد على اللعب العرضي. شاهد كيف خطط والمعركة على الكرة أدت إلى هذا الهدف الحاسم!

trace.output: Brief: GOAL - Elias Okafor (Harbour City) for fan audience in ar

- Harbour City executed a prolonged, patient build-up phase lasting nearly 57 seconds with 17 passes, predominantly short and backward among defenders and midfielders, reflecting their 4-2-3-1 formation and patient short passing style under coach Tomasz Rhee [#moment.build_up, #team_styles].
- The build-up featured multiple progressive passes and carries into the final third by Elias Okafor and Malik Castillo, showing effective midfield control and gradual field tilt (75% in last 10 minutes), which helped break down Seabrook Town’s 3-4-3 defensive shape [#moment.build_up, #last_10_minutes].
- The goal resulted from a well-timed through pass by attacking midfielder Marek Barros to Elias Okafor at around 13 meters from goal during open play, exploiting space behind Seabrook’s wide defensive line, aligning with Harbour City's methodical creation rather than quick counter-attacks or crosses [#moment.assist_type, #moment.situation].
- Seabrook Town’s wide, crossing style and 3-4-3 setup was circumvented by Harbour City’s controlled possession and short passing, preventing the wide overloads and crosses that Seabrook typically rely on, evident from their lower possession and field tilt in the last 10 minutes [#team_styles, #last_10_minutes].

- Elias Okafor scored a goal at 45' from 12.9 meters with his foot in open play, assisted by Marek Barros through a through pass, with an xG of 0.125 [#905]
- The goal leveled the score from 0-0 to 1-0 in favor of Harbour City, changing their match state from trailing to level [#905]
- The build-up to the goal involved 17 passes over 56.9 seconds, started from open play, involving 7 players including Okafor and Barros [#883 to #905]
- Harbour City played a 4-2-3-1 formation with a style of patient short passing under coach Tomasz Rhee, dominating possession with 57% and 89.9% pass accuracy in the last 10 minutes
- Seabrook Town played 3-4-3 with wide crossing play under Mara Lindholm, held 43% possession and had fewer chances and box touches in the last 10 minutes
